notes.title: Updates so far
notes.content:
This is a quick summary of the changes made to the game since launch, all in one place:

- Xbox controller support added and recently bugfixed
- Laser pointer effect added to improve accuracy with a controller
- Left handed control scheme for keyboard added
- Major resolution bugfixes for Mac
- Volume control slider added in the in-game settings
- Leaderboard connectivity services improved and bugfixed
- Slight difficulty rebalancing
- Out of bounds glitch fixed
- Various minor visual improvements

Also, the golden joystick award we won from the TERMINUS festival ːsteamhappyː:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32705764/267ee6a4880ce25c09c7e53e794f42e9a7c11ae3.jpg[/img]

Things are happening on our end with a follow up to this game, so keep your eyes peeled for our upcoming release!
